keySentence: Mole decided to leave home and explore the world.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Mole saw the big world outside. There were fields and rivers. He was brave and curious. Mole decided to leave home and explore the world.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Mole had never seen anything so beautiful before. Wide fields and a shining river stretched before him. He saw forests and hills he had never known about. Mole decided to leave home and explore the world bravely. His heart was beating fast with excitement and a little fear. But he knew he could not stay underground forever.
facts.Word cards: Mole = 두더지 / never = 한 번도 ~없이 / river = 강 / seen = 본 적 있는 / sparkling = 반짝이는
